title: SF327 (2025-2026 Regular): Lawful carry and possession of firearms at the State Fairgrounds establishment

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/327/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: as-filed (introduced) text; no passage vote recorded. Section 1 and Section 2 are effective August 1, 2025. The rest of subd. 17 in the text is unchanged existing law (the bill's changes are the Section 1 proviso and new clause (5)); the new clause (5) defines a term the text never otherwise uses.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 37.16): The society may make all bylaws, ordinances, and rules consistent with law which it considers necessary or proper for the government of the fairgrounds and all fairs to be held on them, and for the protection, health, safety, and comfort of the public on the fairgrounds provided no bylaw, ordinance, or rule prohibits the lawful carry or possession of firearms consistent with section 624.714.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 17): (5) "Governmental entity" includes but is not limited to the State Agricultural Society when it conducts activities on the State Fairgrounds consistent with the public purposes identified in section 37.01.
